name: sid.sdk.global.utils.sms.SIDSMSBroadcastReceiver
description: During Sber ID sign-in, SIDSDK listens for Google's SMS Retriever result and asks the user to approve using a received verification message. The sign-in screen sets up this listener only while authentication is active.
disableEffect: Turning off this declared entry alone does not stop the SMS consent step, because the active sign-in screen registers its listener directly.
